author: Firstline
quote: The story, art, voice acting and gameplay are all really great. The game suffers most from writing of the female characters which is absolute trash, but thank god they don't play a larger role in the game.

author: Firstline
quote: The graphics and world look beautiful, but instead of focusing on that, the developers should have prioritized improving the gameplay. It's just a cheap knockoff of Commandos and Minami games. It's obvious the game aims to be story-driven, packed with dialogue and cutscenes, yet it fails miserably. Most characters are boring, and as the story progresses, it becomes laughably bad—especially the main character.

author: Firstline
quote: It has a great gameplay, but don't expect much from the writing, because both the story and the characters are laughably bad.

author: Firstline
quote:
I played the original Alan Wake at least eight times, and it’s one of my favorite games. But whatever the hell this was, it’s not Alan Wake.

First of all, it’s barely even a game. Action makes up maybe 5% of the experience — the rest is just walking, watching cutscenes, and walking through a musical number (because apparently that’s what a horror game needs now). While the story and pacing in the first game were top-notch, here they’re just bad.

The characters suffer the same problem. The original had unique, memorable characters with great dialogue. In this one, I couldn’t care less about anyone — they’re all incredibly boring. The whole game feels like it was written by a pretentious theater kid.

The only positive thing is the graphics. Everything else is a complete waste of time and money.

I never thought I’d see the fall of Remedy, but after this, it’s clear that nothing good lasts forever.

author: Firstline
quote: Pretty much a downgrade of Desperados 3, with some really overpowered abilities. For me where it suffers the most is the story/characters, because the writing in general just leaves much to be desired. Also the level design requires you to play the same map multiple times to progress the story. This becomes tedious real fast, since all maps (islands) look really similar.

author: Firstline
quote:
Most definitely recommend for someone who enjoys other Remedy games such as Alan Wake, Control, or for someone who loves story-driven games.

POSITIVES
+ story that keeps you hooked
+ graphics (especially lighting)
+ episodic storytelling
+ level design
+ amazing cast of actors
+ time manipulation game mechanics
+ really impressive set pieces (something you don't see in most games)

NEGATIVES
- live action TV Show... I would actually enjoy the show, as a seperate thing because it is good, but here it breaks the flow of the game when you suddenly need to watch (stream!!!) a 20 minute show between episodes, when instead you could be playing the game... and I also dislike the use of live action in a game, but that's a separate matter
- you can't turn off motion blur in the game
